Berikut adalah laporan implementasi untuk **TASK-008: Implement Contact Domain Entity, Model, and Repository**.

### 1. Ringkasan Perubahan
- **Domain Entity & Model**: Membuat domain entity [`Contact`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/base-be-golang/task-008-20260825t164510z-032d074a/internal/domain/contact.go) dengan atribut `Name` (`string`) dan `PhoneNumber` (`string`, tag `phone_number`), field `ID` (kompatibel UUID & numerik), `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`, method `TableName()`, dan custom `UnmarshalJSON`. Pada layer model, dibuat [`model.Contact`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/base-be-golang/task-008-20260825t164510z-032d074a/internal/model/contact.go) sebagai representasi model entity.
- **Repository Interface & Generic Implementation**: Mendefinisikan interface [`ContactRepository`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/base-be-golang/task-008-20260825t164510z-032d074a/internal/repository/contact_repository.go) untuk operasi CRUD (`Store`, `FindAll`, `FindOneByID`, `Update`, `UpdateSelectedCols`, `Delete`, `DeleteByID`, `FindPagedByExpression`, `FindAllByExpression`, `FindOneByExpression`) serta implementasi wrapper generic repository GORM [`GormContactRepository`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/base-be-golang/task-008-20260825t164510z-032d074a/internal/repository/contact_repository.go) dan konstruktor `NewContactRepository` & `NewContactRepositoryPointer`.
- **Database Migrations**: Menambahkan script migrasi tabel `contacts` pada [`000001_create_contacts_table.up.sql`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/base-be-golang/task-008-20260825t164510z-032d074a/database/migrations/000001_create_contacts_table.up.sql) dan [`000001_create_contacts_table.down.sql`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/base-be-golang/task-008-20260825t164510z-032d074a/database/migrations/000001_create_contacts_table.down.sql).
- **Unit Testing**: Menambahkan pengujian komprehensif untuk domain entity, model, dan repository double/mock di [`internal/domain/contact_test.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/base-be-golang/task-008-20260825t164510z-032d074a/internal/domain/contact_test.go), [`internal/model/contact_test.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/base-be-golang/task-008-20260825t164510z-032d074a/internal/model/contact_test.go), dan [`internal/repository/contact_repository_test.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/base-be-golang/task-008-20260825t164510z-032d074a/internal/repository/contact_repository_test.go).
